en: A colorized historical postcard view of a busy open-air market in front of a large Neo-Renaissance style post and telegraph building. Numerous people in early 20th‑century clothing browse stalls with produce and goods under umbrellas in a town square. The central building has two prominent mansard-roofed corner pavilions, arched ground-floor entrances, tall windows, and a clock above the main entrance. Mountains are faintly visible in the background and surrounding townhouses line the adjacent streets. Italian text at the top identifies the location, and an inscription on the façade reads 'R. POSTA E TELEGRAFO'.
